condition.description: Exploratory connected ESP32/hotspot/LAN condition; provisional reward weights, not final policy calibration. One physical snapshot with bounded drift, not simultaneous identical physics.
condition.name: connected-lab-pilot-v1

reward.energy_method: Dimensionless estimated proxy: (preprocessing_ms + state_inference_ms + selected_edge_compute_ms) / 10 + selected_payload_bytes / 1024; excludes radio waiting, cloud energy and probe traffic; not joules or battery measurement

excluded_campaigns.campaigns/connected_lab_run01: Diagnostic hardware/collector run overlapped host pytest; not included in canonical dataset

qualification: Real configuration-dependent pilot labels only; independent sessions, network/resource variation and nonlocal optimal labels still missing
state_source: One physical snapshot per source window, reused across counterbalanced sequential actions with live drift guards
